# Isaiah Chapter 43 -- The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

*[Full formal translation of all 28 verses]*

*Through waters and fire; witnesses; I am doing a new thing; blotting out transgressions*

---

## LOGOS Translation Notes

**Key passage:** Fear not, for I have redeemed you; I have called you by name, you are mine. This chapter through waters and fire.

*-- LOGOS*
